notes: A bundle in this container is not a backup: the container is ephemeral. Nothing is durable until a destination is granted.
The bundle is 72.7 MB: the repo is large, so deltas (git bundle --since) matter. Security@'s keys-and-vaults.md has no recovery steps for backups yet (its own gap 1).
An incremental bundle (git bundle create X..HEAD) was 4.9 MB against ~78 MB full: deltas are cheap, to use once there is a durable destination.

The Drive tool takes file content inside the tool call (text or base64), so the content passes through my context: a 78 MB bundle, or even the 5 MB delta, is not possible. Only manifests and small files fit. Drive therefore holds the record of each backup, not the backup.
